Feature: Alarms Management

  Scenario Outline: Event log includes all alarm occurrences
    Given the event log is empty
    When an alarm occurs
    Then the event log should include the alarm occurrence
    Examples:
      | alarm_type |
      | OxygenLow  |
      | PressureHigh |

  Scenario Outline: Event log includes all alarm inhibitions, cancellations, resets, acknowledgements
    Given the event log is empty
    When an alarm occurs
    And the alarm is inhibited
    Then the event log should include the alarm inhibition
    Examples:
      | alarm_type |
      | OxygenLow  |
      | PressureHigh |

    Given the event log is empty
    When an alarm occurs
    And the alarm is cancelled
    Then the event log should include the alarm cancellation
    Examples:
      | alarm_type |
      | OxygenLow  |
      | PressureHigh |

    Given the event log is empty
    When an alarm occurs
    And the alarm is reset
    Then the event log should include the alarm reset
    Examples:
      | alarm_type |
      | OxygenLow  |
      | PressureHigh |

    Given the event log is empty
    When an alarm occurs
    And the alarm is acknowledged
    Then the event log should include the alarm acknowledgement
    Examples:
      | alarm_type |
      | OxygenLow  |
      | PressureHigh |

  Scenario Outline: GUI allows inhibiting alarms
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user selects an alarm to inhibit
    Then the alarm should be inhibited
    Examples:
      | alarm_type |
      | OxygenLow  |
      | PressureHigh |

  Scenario Outline: GUI allows acknowledging alarms
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user selects an alarm to acknowledge
    Then the alarm should be acknowledged
    Examples:
      | alarm_type |
      | OxygenLow  |
      | PressureHigh |

  Scenario Outline: GUI allows cancelling alarms
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user selects an alarm to cancel
    Then the alarm should be cancelled
    Examples:
      | alarm_type |
      | OxygenLow  |
      | PressureHigh |

  Scenario Outline: GUI allows setting an alarm on inspiration tidal volume above threshold
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets an alarm on inspiration tidal volume above 80ml
    Then the alarm should be set
    Examples:
      | tidal_volume |
      | 80           |
      | 100          |
      | 3000         |

  Scenario Outline: GUI has an alarm that fires if for 3 consecutive breaths PIP > user-specified threshold
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets a PIP threshold of 20 cmH2O
    And the PIP is above 20 cmH2O for 3 consecutive breaths
    Then the alarm should fire
    Examples:
      | PIP_threshold |
      | 20            |
      | 25            |
      | 30            |

  Scenario Outline: GUI has an alarm that fires if amount of leakage is > user-specified threshold
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets a leakage threshold of 10 lpm
    And the leakage is above 10 lpm
    Then the alarm should fire
    Examples:
      | leakage_threshold |
      | 10                |
      | 15                |
      | 20                |
